claim: NASA confirms 6 days of total darkness across Earth

consensus.summary: Peer-reviewed scientific consensus and NASA Official Science Briefings confirm this assertion is false.

crossSourceArticles.title: Hoax: NASA Confirmed 6 Days of Total Earth Darkness
crossSourceArticles.snippet: NASA has never issued a warning about days of worldwide total darkness. Such claims originate from recycled clickbait hoaxes that resurface periodically on social media.
